name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Services & Digital Media | Account Management, Performance Reporting & Audience Strategy
summary: Client services and digital marketing professional with 15+ years managing multi-stakeholder accounts across agencies and B2B SaaS. Led paid, inbound, and content strategy for client accounts at Level Agency, advised on ad-spend allocation, ran audience-targeted campaigns, and turned performance data into QBR recommendations. Retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, including agencies serving healthcare clients, by catching adoption issues before they reached the client. Meta Ads certified; hands-on in GA4, Power BI, and SQL.
